<span lang="sr">

<span class="chart-sep">
+
</span>
<span class="verb-term">
past participle
</span>
</p>
</section>
<section class="verb-block">
<h4 class="chart-label">
Placement
</h4>
<div class="verb-examples">
<div class="chart-example verb-example">
<span class="sr" lang="sr">
Гледао сам филм.
</span>
<span class="tr">
I watched a film. (m.)
</span>
</div>
<div class="chart-example verb-example">
<span class="sr" lang="sr">
Ја сам гледао филм.
</span>
<span class="tr">
I watched a film.
</span>
</div>
<div class="chart-example verb-example">
<span class="sr" lang="sr">
Нисам гледао филм.
</span>
<span class="tr">
I did not watch a film. (m.)
</span>
</div>
<div class="chart-example verb-example">
<span class="sr" lang="sr">
Јуче сам гледао филм.
</span>
<span class="tr">
Yesterday I watched a film.
</span>
</div>
</div>
</section>

Tense

<h3>
Future
</h3>
</header>
<section class="verb-block">
<h4 class="chart-label">
Formula
</h4>
<p class="verb-formula">
<span lang="sr">
ћу/ћеш/ће/ћемо/ћете/ће
</span>
<span class="chart-sep">
+
</span>
<span class="verb-term">
infinitive
</span>
</p>
</section>
<section class="verb-block">
<h4 class="chart-label">
Placement / spelling
</h4>
<div class="verb-examples">
<div class="chart-example verb-example">
<span class="sr" lang="sr">
Ја ћу радити.
</span>
<span class="tr">
I will work.
</span>
</div>
<div class="chart-example verb-example">
<span class="sr" lang="sr">
Радићу.
</span>
<span class="tr">
I will work.
</span>
</div>
<div class="chart-example verb-example">
<span class="sr" lang="sr">
Нећу радити.
</span>
<span class="tr">
I will not work.
</span>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<section class="verb-block">
<h4 class="chart-label">
Merged forms
</h4>
<p class="verb-list" lang="sr">
радити → радићу, радићеш, радиће
</p>
</section>
<section class="verb-block">
<h4 class="chart-label">
-ći verbs
</h4>
<p class="verb-list" lang="sr">
ићи ћу, доћи ћу
</p>
</section>
</article>
<article class="chart-panel verb-col" data-tone="clitic">
<header class="chart-panel-head">
<span class="chart-label">
Clitic
</span>
<h3 lang="sr">
се
</h3>
</header>
<section class="verb-block">
<p class="verb-note">
<i lang="sr">
се
</i>
follows the first stressed word.
</p>
<div class="verb-examples">
<div class="chart-example verb-example">
<span class="sr" lang="sr">
Шетам се.
</span>
</div>
<div class="chart-example verb-example">
<span class="sr" lang="sr">
Ја се шетам.
</span>
</div>
<div class="chart-example verb-example">
<span class="sr" lang="sr">
Нисам се шетао.
</span>
</div>
</div>
</section>
</article>
